items.prompt: A man seen from behind stepping into a narrow glowing rift in the air of a dark forest; his legs and back are already dissolving into fine lines and points of light where they cross the threshold, while the wet grass behind him remains ordinary.

alt.ru: Мужчина со спины шагает в узкую светящуюся щель в воздухе тёмного леса; ноги и спина на пороге уже распадаются на тонкие линии и точки света.
alt.en: A man from behind stepping into a narrow glowing rift in the air of a dark forest, his legs and back dissolving into fine lines and points of light at the threshold.
alt.pt: Um homem de costas a entrar numa fenda luminosa estreita no ar de uma floresta escura, as pernas e as costas a desfazer-se em linhas finas e pontos de luz no limiar.
alt.es: Un hombre de espaldas entrando en una estrecha grieta luminosa en el aire de un bosque oscuro, sus piernas y espalda deshaciéndose en finas líneas y puntos de luz en el umbral.
